force_scale: sum of original source force magnitudes, before cancellation
moment_scale: captured group radius times force scale, around captured first-failure wrench origin
objective: Sum of squared per-source normalized weighted prior changes, multiplied by one common positive factor. Every original source, support, friction and unconstrained wrench-preserving baseline stays explicit.
source_changes: Recompute individual force/moment and unsigned point-force corrections, not only aggregate wrench.
acceptance: Load-budget conformance alone never admits engineering stress. Compute actual complete field/resultant/peak correction including mass equilibrium response.
unbudgeted_control: Exact pointwise cone projection with primal, polar, complementarity checks; no numerical optimizer failure accepted.
